clues.it: Olga era accanto a un abbeveratoio e a nord di Bruno.
clues.en: Olga was beside a water trough and north of Bruno.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 3ª colonna, accanto a un abbeveratoio e nell'Ufficio dello Sceriffo.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 3rd column, beside a water trough and in the Sheriff's Office.

clues.it: Vito era nella 6ª colonna, nella 3ª riga e a nord di Dario.
clues.en: Vito was in the 6th column, in the 3rd row and north of Dario.

clues.it: Carla era nella 5ª colonna e in una stanza diversa da Bruno, ma non era accanto a un bancone.
clues.en: Carla was in the 5th column and in a different room from Bruno, but was not beside a bar counter.

clues.it: Giada era nella 9ª colonna e a nord di Paolo, ma non era accanto a uno sgabello da saloon.
clues.en: Giada was in the 9th column and north of Paolo, but was not beside a saloon stool.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Dario era nella 4ª colonna e in una stanza diversa da Olga, ma non era accanto a un bancone.
clues.en: Dario was in the 4th column and in a different room from Olga, but was not beside a bar counter.

clues.it: Paolo era in una stanza diversa da Bruno e nel Saloon.
clues.en: Paolo was in a different room from Bruno and in the Saloon.

clues.it: Marta era accanto a uno sgabello da saloon e da sola all'Emporio.
clues.en: Marta was beside a saloon stool and alone in the General Store.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 10ª riga e a ovest di Dario.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 10th row and west of Dario.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

general_clues.it: 1 seduta su uno sgabello da saloon.
3 accanto a uno sgabello da saloon.

steps.it: Solo Olga può stare nella 1ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 2ª è sua.
steps.en: Olga is the only one who can be in the 1st row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 2nd is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Bruno lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Bruno's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 3rd.

steps.it: L'indizio di Vito lascia una sola casella libera: riga 3ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Vito's own clue leaves a single free square: row 3rd, column 6th.

steps.it: Solo Carla può stare nella 4ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 5ª è sua.
steps.en: Carla is the only one who can be in the 4th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 5th is theirs.

steps.it: Solo Giada può stare nella 5ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 9ª è sua.
steps.en: Giada is the only one who can be in the 5th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 9th is theirs.

steps.en: Sergio is the only one who can be in the 6th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 10th is theirs.

steps.en: Dario is the only one who can be in the 7th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 4th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Paolo più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 8ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Paolo's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 8th, column 8th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Marta lascia una sola casella libera: riga 9ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Marta's own clue leaves a single free square: row 9th, column 7th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Fabio più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 10ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Fabio's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 10th, column 1st.
